title: Explicit affine sections are natural in their algebraic module
statement: Let $i:Z\to Y$ be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], $U$ an affine open of $Y$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], and $A=\Gamma(Y,U)$. Set $F_U=\widetilde{(-)}\circ\operatorname{restrict}_{U\simeq\operatorname{Spec}A}\circ (U\hookrightarrow Y)_*\circ i^*$, with composition in functor order [def-pc-module-pullback]. For an $A$-module $M$ and $m\in M$, define $\gamma_U^M(m)\in\Gamma(i^{-1}U,F_U M)$ by taking the tilde adjunction unit, restricting its global section to the image of $(U\hookrightarrow Y)^{-1}U$ under the affine chart, using the restriction-section identity, pushing forward, and applying the canonical tensor-pullback unit [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. This is an explicit construction; the adjunction unit is pinned by its section formula, rather than an arbitrary witness. For any $A$-linear map $a:M\to P$, $(F_Ua)(\gamma_U^M(m))=\gamma_U^P(a(m))$. For later use an ideal section $b\in\Gamma(U,i.\ker)$ gives the element of $I_U=i.\ker.\operatorname{ideal}(U)$ whose value is its ideal-sheaf inclusion [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf]; its membership follows from range_toModulesι_app. A tuple of these elements gives the pure exterior wedge of their cotangent classes [new-r4-self-tor-conormal-comparison].

proof.text: The ideal section is its actual inclusion, with membership supplied by range_toModulesι_app, and its conormal wedge is the exterior alternating map on those classes. The affine constant section is the explicit composite described in the statement. Naturality of the tilde unit, of restriction of module maps, and of the tensor-pullback unit gives the equality. These three naturality equalities are composed in selfTorAffineSection_map.

theorem selfTorAffineSection_map {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y)
    (U : Y.affineOpens) {M P : ModuleCat.{u} (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u)}
    (a : M ⟶ P) (m : M) :
    ((tilde.functor Γ(Y, U.1) ⋙ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.isoSpec.hom ⋙
      Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.1.ι ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).map a).val.app
        (op (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)) (selfTorAffineSection i U M m) =
      selfTorAffineSection i U P (a m)
